# Salvor Project

> Salvor Project is an international logistics and freight-forwarding company, founded in 2014 and headquartered in İstanbul with a branch office in Dubai, moving cargo across sea, air and land to six continents with 24/7 operations support.

## Key facts

- **Official name:** Salvor Project (also known as Salvor Logistics, Salvor)
- **Founded:** 2014 — 12 years of logistics expertise
- **Headquarters:** Kurtköy Mah. Hazerfen Ahmet Çelebi Cad. No:12/C, Pendik / İstanbul, Turkey
- **Branch office:** Office 304, Burj Al Noor Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Center 1, Dubai, UAE
- **Email:** info@salvorproject.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +90 536 483 90 84
- **Hours:** 24/7 operations support and real-time shipment coordination
- **Languages:** English, Turkish
- **Services (6):** Charter & Project Cargo · RO-RO Shipping · Air Freight · Land Transportation · Warehousing · Container Shipping (FCL/LCL)
- **Markets served (6):** The Americas · Europe · Far East & Asia · Middle East & Gulf · Africa · Russia & CIS
- **Industries:** Manufacturing · Automotive · Retail · E-commerce · Industrial goods · International trade
- **Specialism:** Oversized, heavy and out-of-gauge project cargo — route surveys, permits, lifting and lashing plans, and full or part vessel charters.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.salvorproject.com/): Overview of Salvor Project's freight forwarding and supply chain services across six continents.
- [Services](https://www.salvorproject.com/services/): Detail on the six logistics services — charter & project cargo, RO-RO, air freight, land transportation, warehousing and container shipping.
- [Industries](https://www.salvorproject.com/industries/): Specialised freight solutions for manufacturing, automotive, retail, e-commerce, industrial goods and international trade.
- [Network & Coverage](https://www.salvorproject.com/network/): Global network spanning six continents from hubs in İstanbul and Dubai, with multimodal routing and warehousing.
- [About](https://www.salvorproject.com/about/): Company background, mission and values, the two-hub structure, and the team behind every shipment.
- [FAQ](https://www.salvorproject.com/faq/): Answers on quotes, FCL vs LCL, transit times, customs and documentation, cargo insurance, Incoterms and tracking.
- [Contact](https://www.salvorproject.com/contact/): Request a quote or reach the İstanbul and Dubai offices; 24/7 operations support.
